useCases: Create particle emitter surfaces (volume or shell)
examples: Sphere POP (Geodesic, Freq=4) → Noise POP → organic blob shape
Sphere POP (Grid, Texture=Equirectangular) → environment map projection
troubleshooting: Sphere looks faceted: Increase Frequency for Geodesic or Rows/Columns for Grid
Texture seams visible: Try different Texture Method
Partial sphere angles wrong: Check Detail page U/V angle ranges
Normals incorrect: Ensure Normal is set to Point for smooth shading
description: Creates spherical shapes in Geodesic (equally-spaced triangles), Grid (latitude/longitude), Tetrahedron, or Shared Points at Poles modes. Supports ellipsoid radii, partial spheres, fish-eye/equirectangular texture mapping.
